music.name: almost monday
music.why: Catchy, Coldplay/1975-flavored indie pop from a fast-rising trio, in a historic SF room on a Monday night.
music.summary: San Diego indie-pop trio almost monday play The Castro on their "Thank God It's Almost Monday" tour. Doors 7pm, show 8pm, all ages.

music.name: Amantes del Futuro
music.why: Four Latin acts blending cumbia, sonidero and dance-floor rhythms in one of SF's classic ballrooms.
music.summary: Mexican psychedelic-cumbia band Amantes del Futuro headline Psyched! Fest 2026 at Great American Music Hall, with Turbo Sonidero, Grupo Gallardo and Sonido Aztlan. Doors 7 PM.

music.name: Bebe Stockwell
music.why: Catch Columbia-signed 'Love Me Back' songwriter in an intimate room on a Monday night, with Yale-grad folk act Khatumu opening.
music.summary: Boston-born folk-pop singer-songwriter Bebe Stockwell plays Rickshaw Stop with Khatumu opening. Doors 7pm, all ages.

music.name: Bobby McFerrin & Motion
music.why: A 10-time Grammy winner leading a midday, sing-along circle in an intimate Berkeley room.
music.summary: Bobby McFerrin joins Bay Area vocal group MOTION (Bryan Dyer, David Worm, Destani Wolf) for a Circlesongs afternoon of improvised, audience-joined singing. Doors 11:30AM.

music.name: Doja Cat
music.why: Arena-scale pop and rap show from one of the biggest live acts touring, with Latto opening.
music.summary: Doja Cat brings her Tour Ma Vie World Tour, supporting her album Vie, to Chase Center with Latto as special guest.

music.name: Geese
music.why: One of the year's most talked-about indie rock bands, with critics' album-of-the-year buzz, live in a historic 2,800-cap theater.
music.summary: Indie rock band Geese bring their Getting Killed Again Tour to Oakland's Fox Theater, with Bill Orcutt supporting. Doors 7pm, show 8pm, all ages.

music.name: Hovvdy
music.why: Hushed, warm bedroom-pop songs in an intimate converted-chapel room on a Monday night.
music.summary: Austin indie-pop duo Hovvdy play The Chapel in the Mission, with Emma Ogier supporting.

music.name: Last Dinosaurs
music.why: Indie-dance-punk favorites behind Zoom and Apollo on a West Coast tour stop.
music.summary: Australian indie rock/dance-punk band Last Dinosaurs (Brisbane) play The Catalyst in Santa Cruz. Doors 7pm, show 8pm, ages 16+.

music.name: “Motown On Mondays” DJ Night (Madrone Art Bar)
music.why: A reliable, cheap weeknight dance floor for soul and Motown lovers, free before 9pm.
music.summary: Weekly Monday Motown dance night at Madrone Art Bar with hosts DJ Gordo Cabeza and Timoteo Gigante, spinning classic Motown, remixes and songs with the same soulful DNA.

music.name: New Constellations
music.why: Catch the dreamy synth-pop duo behind the 220M-stream "Hot Blooded" in an intimate Divisadero room.
music.summary: Portland dream-pop/synthwave duo New Constellations (Harlee Case and Josh Smith, of "Hot Blooded") play The Independent on the It Comes In Waves Tour, with Vox Rea. Doors 7:30 PM.

music.name: She Wants Revenge
music.why: Post-punk/darkwave favorites mark 20 years since their debut in an intimate mountain-town hall — about an hour south of SF.
music.summary: She Wants Revenge's 20th-anniversary tour stops at Felton Music Hall in the Santa Cruz Mountains, with Rosegarden Funeral Party opening. Doors 7pm, 21+, general admission standing room.

music.name: Shoshana Bean
music.why: A rare Bay Area club-sized set from one of Broadway's biggest voices, in Yoshi's Jack London Square room.
music.summary: Grammy-winning Broadway vocalist Shoshana Bean (Wicked, Waitress, Hell's Kitchen, now The Lost Boys) plays two intimate shows at Yoshi's Oakland: doors 7:00 PM / show 7:30 PM and doors 9:15 PM / show 9:30 PM.

music.name: Allah-Las
music.why: Sun-baked surf-psych and garage jangle in one of SF's most ornate rooms.
music.summary: Los Angeles psych-rock band Allah-Las play Great American Music Hall as part of Psyched! Fest 2026, with April Magazine supporting.

music.name: Artms
music.address: 1300 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94109
music.why: K-pop act on their first world tour in an intimate historic ballroom rather than an arena.
music.summary: ARTMS, the South Korean girl group formed by Modhaus (Heejin, Haseul, Kim Lip, Jinsoul, Choerry), bring their Art of Blue Blood World Tour to The Regency Ballroom. Doors 6PM, all ages.

music.name: Dinosaur Jr. - Fall Tour 2026 with special guest Stef Chura
music.why: Loud, fuzzy alt-rock legends J Mascis, Lou Barlow and Murph with Detroit's Stef Chura opening.
music.summary: Dinosaur Jr. bring their fall 2026 tour to Ace of Spades in Sacramento with special guest Stef Chura. Note: this is the Sacramento date; the San Francisco show is Oct 18 at the Castro Theatre.

music.name: Doja Cat
music.address: 500 David J Stern Walk, Sacramento, CA 95814
music.why: Arena-scale pop and rap spectacle from one of the genre's biggest stars, a short drive from the Bay.
music.summary: Doja Cat brings her Tour Ma Vie World Tour to Golden 1 Center in Sacramento, in support of her fifth studio album Vie, with Latto as special guest. Doors 6:30 PM.

music.name: Geese
music.why: One of the year's most talked-about indie rock bands, with critics' album-of-the-year buzz, live in a historic 2,800-cap theater.
music.summary: Indie rock band Geese bring their Getting Killed Again Tour to Oakland's Fox Theater, with Bill Orcutt supporting. Doors 7pm, show 8pm, all ages.

music.name: Hazlett
music.why: A live-band night at one of SF's best mid-size rooms if you want a guitar-driven show instead of a club.
music.summary: Hazlett plays August Hall, a 1,000-capacity downtown San Francisco room, on a Tuesday night. Doors and showtime are listed for 8:00 PM.

music.name: Laura Veirs, Karl Blau
music.why: Two long-running Pacific Northwest folk songwriters in an intimate room.
music.summary: Indie folk singer-songwriter Laura Veirs plays Cafe du Nord with Pacific Northwest multi-instrumentalist Karl Blau.

music.name: matt pond PA + Anya Marina
music.why: Intimate indie-folk night from a long-running band and its collaborator Anya Marina, in a small Marin room.
music.summary: Indie-folk songwriter matt pond PA plays the HopMonk Session Room in Novato with Anya Marina supporting, on their 2026 tour. Doors 7pm, show 8pm.

music.name: The Moth StorySLAM - FRENEMIES
music.why: Live, true, first-person stories judged by the audience — a low-key Tuesday night out in Berkeley.
music.summary: Open-mic storytelling competition: anyone can tell a true five-minute story on the theme FRENEMIES — the thin line between friend and foe. Doors 6:00 PM, show 7:00 PM.

music.name: Sawyer Hill
music.why: Live singer-songwriter show in an intimate Divisadero room on a Tuesday night.
music.summary: Sawyer Hill plays The Independent on the Everybody's Home, Nobody's Happy Tour. Doors 7:30 PM, show 8 PM; VIP Gold Experience packages available.

music.name: SF’s Free Concerts & Food Trucks: “Civic Center Soundtrack” (Every Tue/Thu)
music.address: Between the SF Main Library and Asian Art Museum, Civic Center, San Francisco, CA
music.why: Free live music and food trucks on your lunch break in the middle of Civic Center.
music.summary: Free midday concert series by Illuminate at Fulton Plaza, Tuesdays and Thursdays noon to 3 pm, with three performers a day and rotating food trucks.

music.name: Shakey Graves
music.why: Intimate Americana/folk-rock night from a singular Austin songwriter in one of SF's most beautiful historic theaters; tickets nearly gone.
music.summary: Shakey Graves (Alejandro Rose-Garcia) brings his Fondness, Etc. Tour to the Castro Theatre with Wild Pink supporting. Doors 7pm, show 8pm, all ages.

music.name: Techno Tuesdays - DJ Jehnee
music.why: Free late-night techno on a Tuesday, no ticket needed.
music.summary: A free weekly techno night at the Make-Out Room in San Francisco's Mission, with DJ Jehnee on the decks from 10pm to 2am.

music.name: Tōth
music.why: Witty, emotionally potent songwriting and a communal, come-together live show from a Rubblebucket alum.
music.summary: Brooklyn-based multi-instrumentalist Tōth (Alex Toth of Rubblebucket) presents his third album, And The Voice Said, co-produced by Caroline Rose and featuring Kimbra. Doors 7pm.

music.name: Twin Peaks: Conversation With The Stars
music.why: Rare chance to hear Twin Peaks cast stories live, with VIP photo and autograph packages.
music.summary: A fan celebration of the TV series Twin Peaks with cast members Ray Wise and Dana Ashbrook, featuring on-camera and behind-the-scenes recollections, photo ops and autographs. Doors 7PM, show 7:30PM.

music.name: Bedouine
music.why: Intimate, dreamy folk from Bedouine in a beloved listening room, with new material from Neon Summer Skin.
music.summary: Bedouine plays The Freight in Berkeley on her fall 2026 North American tour, in support of the upcoming album Neon Summer Skin. Doors at 7pm, all ages.

music.name: Chipped Nail Polish and Andrew St. James
City of The Sun
music.why: Cinematic instrumental indie/folk with flamenco and blues touches, live in a classic Divisadero room.
music.summary: City of The Sun, the instrumental duo of guitarist John Pita and percussionist Zach Para, play The Independent on their 2026 North American tour.

music.name: Diiv
music.why: Hazy, guitar-drenched shoegaze from a modern indie favorite in an ornate 600-capacity room, part of Psych Fest 2026.
music.summary: Brooklyn dream-pop/shoegaze band DIIV play Great American Music Hall, with Pink Breath of Heaven and a Mutant Otter DJ set, as part of Psychedelic Fest 2026.

music.name: Kepi Ghoulie Electric, The Bloodtypes, Pussy Velour
music.why: Classic Bay Area pop-punk at one of SF's best small rock clubs, with two local garage openers.
music.summary: Kepi Ghoulie brings his fully electric pop-punk set to Bottom of the Hill, with garage punk new wave from The Bloodtypes and garage rock from Pussy Velour. 21+, doors 8:00PM, music 8:30PM.

music.name: Kylie Cantrall
music.why: A rare Bay Area headline show from a rising Disney-born pop star in one of SF's classic theaters.
music.summary: Pop singer and actress Kylie Cantrall (Descendants, Dancing with the Stars) plays The Warfield on her 2026 tour.

music.name: Malcolm Todd
music.why: Bedroom-pop-turned-indie breakout in a sold-out room at one of the Bay's best historic theaters.
music.summary: Malcolm Todd brings his Do That Again Tour to the Fox Theater in Oakland with opener 54 Ultra. All ages; doors 7pm, show 8pm. Sold out at the box office.

music.name: Maurice Tani | Peacetown
music.why: A free midweek evening of Supercalifornographic Americana songwriting from a Bay Area veteran with six acclaimed albums.
music.summary: Alt-country and Americana bandleader Maurice Tani plays the free Peacetown concert series in The Abbey at Hopmonk Tavern, 6:00-8:30 PM.

music.name: Movie Night at The Uptown - The Birds
music.why: A classic-film night out in a historic Napa theater, worth the drive for Hitchcock fans.
music.summary: Screening of Hitchcock's The Birds as part of the Uptown Theatre's Movie Night series in downtown Napa.

music.name: Nahko and Medicine for the People 'HOKA' 10th Anniversary Tour
music.why: A rare 10-year anniversary run-through of a modern folk-medicine classic in an intimate club.
music.summary: Nahko celebrates a decade of the album HOKA with re-recorded versions of its songs, including Tus Pies, Love Letters to God, Make a Change and Runner. 21+, with support from Louyah.

lineup.name: Nahko and Medicine for the People

music.name: Nerd Nite SF #165
music.why: A long-running geeky lecture night at the Rickshaw Stop; reportedly one of the last there before the series moves to a smaller venue.
music.summary: Monthly Nerd Nite SF: three short, funny talks on offbeat science and culture in a rock-club setting, drinks in hand.

music.name: TEN
music.address: 1300 Van Ness Ave, San Francisco, CA 94109
music.why: A rare Bay Area date for a long-running British melodic rock act, in one of SF's classic 1,400-capacity ballrooms.
music.summary: TEN, the British melodic hard rock band, plays The Regency Ballroom in San Francisco on Wednesday, October 21.

music.name: Todd Rundgren
music.why: A rock and pop-production legend in one of SF's most beautiful historic theatres.
music.summary: Todd Rundgren plays the Castro Theatre on the Damned If I Do Tour, an all-ages show. Doors 7pm, show 8pm.

music.name: Yana
music.why: Catch rising alt-pop artist Yana live on her Feelings Are Forever tour at an intimate Mission District room.
music.summary: Yana plays Brick & Mortar Music Hall on The Feelings Are Forever Tour. Doors 7pm, show 8pm.

music.name: A Split Second,  Crash Course in Science
music.why: Rare US date for a Belgian EBM classic alongside Crash Course in Science, in one of SF's most ornate rooms.
music.summary: Belgian EBM/new-beat pioneers A Split Second and synthpop act Crash Course in Science headline a night of the four-night Substance San Francisco festival, with Automelodi, Vioflesh, Pink Stiletto and God Tongue supporting.

music.name: Arcade Karaoke: SF’s Wild New Thursday Night Party + $3 Shots (SF)
music.why: Free-entry Thursday party where you sing with a live band and game all night, with $3 shots every hour on the hour.
music.summary: Weekly Thursday karaoke night with a live band setup, 1000+ songs, Guitar Hero, drum set, piano and arcade games on giant projectors, hosted by MC Dirty Murty. Two-drink minimum; shots and sodas count.
music.price: Free with RSVP (21+); VIP Rockstar Pass $10

music.name: Every Thursday: “Inner Circle” Dance Party at White Rabbit (SF)
music.why: A free, no-cover weekly dance night with rotating guest DJs — an easy midweek pick for house and disco fans.
music.summary: Inner Circle is a long-running free weekly Thursday night at White Rabbit in the Marina, with guest DJs spinning house, disco, remixes, currents and classics from 9pm until late.
